baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًا وَإِنَاثًا contrasted with يَجْعَلُ ... عَقِيمًا
baseline_models.mechanism: The causative pairing verb configures its underresolved plural object with male and female issue, while the second clause makes a distributive person an infertile state. Knowledge and capacity close the contrast as informed, effective state assignment.

activation_trace.role: Making one thing a counterpart or class with another supplies the configuring act that combines the two sex categories.
The literal male category supplies one member of the reproductive configuration.
The literal female category supplies the other member of the reproductive configuration.
Causing a thing to be in a state makes infertility an assigned condition rather than a free-standing label.
Failure of womb or person to receive or produce offspring supplies the reproductive zero-state.
Knowledge as disclosure to the knower marks the assignment as informed.
Effective capacity supplies the ability to realize each configured outcome.

changed_reading.before: A surface pass can hear a marriage of males to females followed by an unrelated statement about barrenness.
changed_reading.after: The verse presents one coordinated reproductive configuration: mixed male-and-female issue versus an individually made no-issue state.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عَقِيمًا after paired plurality and under يَجْعَلُ ... يَشَاءُ
baseline_models.mechanism: Several infertility branches portray blocked reception, rigid passage, or a separating barrier. Read together with state-making and bounded measure, the final condition can be modeled as a deliberately set termination of generative throughput, without replacing its ordinary reproductive sense.

activation_trace.role: Blocked loins and dried joints supply a bodily image of passage becoming unable to transmit.
A knot or barrier separating straw from grain supplies a material image of generative flow ending at a boundary.
State-making makes the boundary an effected condition.
Will attached to an outcome supplies selection rather than accidental blockage.
A thing reaching its set amount supplies the notion of a bounded generative outcome.

changed_reading.before: Infertility is only an empty absence at the end of the list.
changed_reading.after: Infertility remains literal but also becomes the configured boundary at which continuation or transmission stops.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier counterfactual could have made the plural object one community, yet instead selects differentiated admission. Its شاء + جعلهم grammar revises focus pairing from a merely demographic mixture into one instance of willed plurality: counterparts are joined without being flattened into one.

activation_trace.role: Will governs both unrealized uniformity and selective admission, supplying a choice among collective configurations.
Making the plural object into a state supplies the same state-configuring construction used in the focus.
Numerical oneness supplies the unrealized uniform alternative against which paired difference becomes legible.
Joining each counterpart to another anchors designed plurality in the focus verb.

structural_cues: 42:8 repeats شاء and جعلهم around an unrealized أمة واحدة, while 42:50 repeats the plural object, will, and state-making around paired categories.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated grammar and the one-versus-selected plurality contrast; I infer that pairing preserves differentiated plurality by design. A live alternative is that the two formulas independently assert will and carry no cross-domain model.

changed_reading.before: Mixed male and female issue is simply one demographic result.
changed_reading.after: The mixed result exemplifies a broader pattern in which difference is intentionally composed rather than erased into uniformity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier making of pairs from selves and livestock is immediately coupled to bringing forth progeny. That sequence strengthens the focus verb as a productive arrangement: paired relation is the medium of propagation, and infertility is its explicit disabled contrast.

activation_trace.role: Bringing an arrangement into existence supplies the initiating act for the paired reproductive order.
Counterpart pairs in humans and livestock supply the concrete relation through which propagation proceeds.
Progeny and descendants make multiplication the functional consequence of the paired arrangement.
The focus causative pairing anchors the earlier propagation mechanism in the mixed male-and-female outcome.
Literal infertility supplies the contrasting failure of the propagation medium to yield offspring.

structural_cues: 42:11 places أزواجا twice before يذرؤكم فيه; 42:50 places the same pairing root directly before the barren alternative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pairs followed by progeny and the focus supplies pairs opposed to infertility; I infer an enabling arrow from coupled arrangement to propagation. The live alternative is that فيه names the created arrangement generally and does not specify a causal biological medium.

changed_reading.before: Pairing is only the label for one mixed offspring outcome.
changed_reading.after: Pairing is a generative arrangement that enables propagation, making the barren clause its mechanistic counter-state.

context_deltas.mechanism: Provision is spread or constricted, and later sent down in a measured amount, each under will and informed knowledge. The focus ending عليم قدير therefore carries both realized capacity and calibrated limit: mixed issue and infertility become allotments on a known scale, not an unexplained burst of power.

activation_trace.role: Spreading against contraction supplies the expansive end of an allocation scale.
A apportioned gift supplies the distributive frame for outcomes given to different recipients.
Constriction to a smaller amount supplies the limiting pole opposed to expansion.
Knowledge closes the provision scale and parallels the focus closing attribute.
Delivering something downward supplies the controlled release of an allotted amount.
A specified amount explicitly supplies calibration rather than mere ability.
Knowledge of inward circumstance supplies the informational basis for measured release.
Bounded amount remains available inside قدير and anchors the calibrated reading in the focus ending.
Infertility supplies the zero or closed end of the reproductive allotment scale.

structural_cues: 42:12 clusters spread, allotment, will, constriction, and knowledge.
42:27 blocks unlimited expansion, then places measured descent under will and closes with informed seeing.
42:50 likewise places selected outcomes under will and closes with knowledge plus q-d-r.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring scales of expansion, constriction, measured delivery, will, and knowledge; I infer that the focus outcomes are calibrated allotments. A live alternative is that قدير in 42:50 denotes only unrestricted ability and contributes no quantitative nuance.

changed_reading.before: The ending says only that God can impose whichever reproductive result he chooses.
changed_reading.after: The ending also frames each result as a knowingly measured allotment, while withholding any claim that humans can infer its rationale.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cultivation yields through seed, rain revives and spreads growth, and wind carries motion until it is stilled and vessels become inert. Those whole-surah flow images activate the focus branches of fertile land and sterile wind: reproduction can be modeled as carrier throughput, with عقيما marking a channel that neither inseminates nor delivers yield.

activation_trace.role: Casting seed and cultivation supply a process whose value appears as later yield.
Life-giving rain descending from the sky supplies the fertile carrier absent from a sterile wind.
The split-root rain image preserves the relief-bearing delivery side of the same fertile carrier.
Rain reviving dry herbage supplies the transition from blocked potential to spreading life.
Loss of motion supplies the interruption of a carrier that had enabled movement.
Wind and moving air supply the carrier whose activity can be enabled or stopped.
Rest after motion supplies the resulting inert state when the carrier is withdrawn.
Fertile, rapidly growing land anchors the productive side of the ecological transfer in a focus word.
A sterile wind that neither pollinates nor brings rain anchors failed carrier throughput in the focus adjective.

structural_cues: 42:20 repeats harvest as an outcome-bearing process.
42:28 moves from cut-off hope to rain and spreading mercy.
42:33 makes will stop wind, after which moving vessels remain fixed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seed, rain revival, wind transport, and stoppage; I supply the common arrow carrier flow enables yield and its interruption prevents yield. The materially live alternative is that these are only analogies and that the focus remains exclusively biological.

changed_reading.before: Barrenness is a static personal property opposite having children.
changed_reading.after: Barrenness can additionally be pictured as interrupted generative circulation: a carrier is present in the system but produces no pollination, delivery, or continuation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ownership and creation frame lists daughters as gift, then sons as gift; the focus adds both together and then infertility. The focus thus closes a four-way distribution under sovereign, unrequited giving, and its object pronoun most naturally resumes the recipients of those gifts.

activation_trace.role: Dominion supplies the governing frame within which the outcome distribution is made.
Bringing creation into existence locates the four outcomes inside creation rather than human acquisition.
Giving without exchange makes daughters and sons unearned gifts and supplies the distribution's social relation.
The female-only grant supplies the first cell later recombined by the focus pairing verb.
The male-only grant supplies the second cell later recombined by the focus pairing verb.
Pairing or classing together combines the two single-category grants into the mixed third cell.
Literal infertility supplies the fourth cell in which neither category is granted.

structural_cues: 42:49-50 forms the ordered sequence females, males, males-and-females, infertile.
Repeated لمن يشاء and من يشاء distribute the outcomes among recipients.
The opening ملك and يخلق frame all four cells before the closing عليم قدير.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an uninterrupted four-item syntax and repeated gift recipients; I infer that هم resumes those recipients and that the focus completes a four-cell allocation. A live alternative is that يزوجهم foregrounds pairing the offspring categories themselves rather than the recipients' receipt of both.

changed_reading.before: Read alone, the focus can sound like an isolated act of marrying or pairing followed by barrenness.
changed_reading.after: It completes a gift-based distribution: female issue, male issue, both categories together, or no issue.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayah gives three alternative channels of divine communication, then the next ayah again uses جعل and شاء for revelation made into guiding light. This adjacent alternative architecture activates the focus as governance by modes: reproductive outcomes are not a flat inventory but distinct channels through which giving is realized or withheld.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge cast secretly supplies one communication channel in the following modal distribution.
A screening barrier supplies a second channel defined by mediated access.
Messenger and message supply a third channel realized through an emissary.
Will governs what is conveyed and repeats the selective operator of the focus.
Making revelation into a new state as light repeats the focus's state-transforming verb.
Illumination supplies the realized effect of the selected communicative mode.
Will again selects recipients, tightening the formal echo with the focus.
The focus's configuring verb anchors the modal architecture in a concrete reproductive outcome.
State-making supplies the exact bridge from reproductive condition to the following made-light construction.

structural_cues: 42:50 and 42:51 both order alternatives with أو and close them under divine attributes.
42:50-52 repeats شاء, then repeats جعل in the movement from reproductive condition to guiding light.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent alternative channels and exact شاء/جعل repetition; I infer a rhetorical bridge in which divine action is differentiated by mode. The live alternative is a clean topic transition from creation to revelation with no mechanism shared beyond sovereignty.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a static list of reproductive results.
changed_reading.after: The results can be read as an architecture of distinct realized modes, immediately echoed by distinct modes of communication and guidance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers collective joining and division into a reproductive sentence. It remains anchored in the counterpart-pairing branch of يُزَوِّجُهُمْ and in the explicit male/female difference, but downstream prose should present it only as a structural resonance, not as a social allegory that replaces the reproductive sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ز و ج as joining counterparts while ذُكْرَانًا وَإِنَاثًا keeps their distinction visible

activation_trace.role: Two separated parties supply the surah's early image of plurality organized by division.
Union into one direction supplies the unrealized alternative of flattened collectivity.
Scattering into parts supplies the destructive form of difference the commanded order resists.
Joining what was separate supplies a collective counterpart to the focus's paired composition.
Gathering dispersed creatures supplies the macrocosmic ability to recombine plurality.
Joining one counterpart with another anchors the resonance in the focus without erasing male/female distinction.

changed_reading.before: Pairing means only that a recipient has a mixed set of children.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, pairing images a constructive joining of differentiated counterparts, distinct from both fragmentation and flattening oneness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rare ع ق م branch for opaque or non-deriving speech just before the surah turns to divine speech and transmission. The adjacency and the focus adjective keep the activation traceable, but downstream prose must label it a cross-domain echo of failed continuation, never a lexical claim that عَقِيمًا here means speechlessness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَقِيمًا as the state in which no offspring or continuation is produced

activation_trace.role: Speech from which no form is derived supplies a linguistic image of production ending without continuation.
Intelligible utterance linking speakers supplies the following domain of successful transmission.
Secretly conveyed knowledge supplies transmission that reaches another despite hiddenness.
Prevented direct access supplies a boundary that transmission can nevertheless route around.
A messenger and message supply generated continuation from sender to recipient.

changed_reading.after: As a contained branch echo, barrenness is non-derivation or failed continuation, set beside communication channels that successfully carry an originating act onward.

strongest_changes: 42:49 resolves the focus into the third and fourth cells of a four-way, gift-based reproductive distribution.
42:11 makes pairing a propagation medium, while 42:12 and 42:27 recast the closing q-d-r cluster as calibrated allotment as well as ability.
Harvest, rain, and stilled wind activate an exploratory carrier-flow model in which infertility is interrupted generative throughput.
42:51-52 echo the focus's alternatives, will, and state-making as an adjacent architecture of differentiated modes.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah activation came from repeated شاء/جعل/قدر grammar and from concrete propagation, measure, rain, wind, joining, and transmission branches. The immediate gift tetrad remained primary, while the ecological, collective, and linguistic readings were retained with explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the object pronoun in يُزَوِّجُهُمْ foregrounds recipients receiving both categories or the pairing of the offspring categories themselves.
How much quantitative measure and constriction remain active in قَدِيرٌ at 42:50 rather than simple effective power.
The ecological, collective, and nonderivation models are traceable resonances but should not displace the reproductive syntax.
